messages.subject: Issue 79 in stan: explicit monitoring of lp__ variable fails in rstan
parts:
Status: New
Owner: ----
Labels: Type-Defect Priority-Medium

New issue 79 by sdw.p...@gmail.com: explicit monitoring of lp__ variable
fails in rstan
http://code.google.com/p/stan/issues/detail?id=79

What steps will reproduce the problem?

ex_model_code <- '
parameters {
real alpha[2,3];
real beta[2];
}
model {
for (i in 1:2) for (j in 1:3)
alpha[i, j] ~ normal(0, 1);
for (i in 1:2)
beta ~ normal(0, 2);
}
'

## fit the model
fit1 <- stan(model_code = ex_model_code, chains = 4)
fit2 <- stan(model_code = ex_model_code, chains = 4,
pars=c("alpha", "lp__"))


What is the expected output? What do you see instead?

fit2 does not include lp__

What version of the product are you using? On what operating system?

rstan (Version 1.0.3, packaged: 2012-10-25 23:12:45 UTC, GitRev:
965de49cc0ea)


on MacOSX Lion, R 2.15.1

Please provide any additional information below.
